events.reasoning: The question explicitly asks for top Uniswap pools by TVL. The uniswap-pools feed returns exactly that (Uniswap v3 only) and the 10-pool bundle gives a reasonable, commonly expected "top 10" result at low cost. No need to pay for cross-protocol coverage.

Top 10 is a standard, user-expected cutoff for "top pools" queries: it reveals the leading pools while keeping cost low. Ten pools are sufficient to identify the current market leaders and any near-competitive pools.

The data costs 0.01 HBAR and directly answers the question with timely on-chain TVL figures. That's inexpensive relative to the value of an accurate, current top-10 list; I value this specific answer at 0.02 HBAR (double the purchase price) given its utility.

The purchased dataset contains a live Messari/The Graph snapshot of Uniswap V3 pools (10 pools). That is enough to report the top 10 pools by TVL from this source right now. Limitations: only 10 pools were fetched (so this answers “top 10” from this feed, not the entire Uniswap universe beyond those rows), and a small set of pools with implausible TVL values were explicitly excluded by the provider (those exclusions are listed in the provenance).
